user_goal: Require Plotkeeper pop-out to request a brand-new Windows default-browser window, not merely another tab.

authority.verbatim_text: Make sure it opens a brand new browser window and doesnt just open a new tab in a current window!  continue!

baseline.protected_ref: committed pop-out and private-connector candidate before new-window clarification
baseline.protection_evidence: clean single main worktree and green 73-test installed candidate
baseline.selection_reason: Preserve all prior behavior while tightening only the external-browser launch mode.

semantic_changes: Invoke the default-browser controller with a new-window request for the exact validated Plotkeeper URL.
No arbitrary URL launch, browser-specific executable selection, non-loopback bind, connector change, release, version bump, or publication.

invariants: Every prior connector and pop-out invariant remains binding.
The launch target remains the exact same-origin current Plotkeeper surface.
Browser or OS policy may override a standards-compliant new-window request and must not be misrepresented as technically forceable.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Pop out requests a brand-new window from the Windows default browser for the exact current Plotkeeper path and query.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Calling the generic default-browser opener without new-window intent, opening an arbitrary URL, or claiming control over browser policy.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Plotkeeper user and Windows default browser

proof_requirements.claim: A regression captures the opener call and proves new=1 with the exact same-origin URL; live UI reports successful handoff.
proof_requirements.required_environment: unit HTTP harness plus installed live Plotkeeper and Windows default browser
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: focused regression, full suite, and one live pop-out click
proof_requirements.expected_observation: exact URL, new-window mode 1, successful handoff, and no unrelated behavior change

release_requirements.required_receipt: validated local installed behavior only; publication requires separate authority

stop_conditions: Missing new-window invocation proof, URL/origin regression, independent non-PASS, or unexpected diff.
known_discrepancies: The parent implementation used webbrowser.open(url), whose default new=0 permits reuse of an existing browser surface.

requirement_trace.authority: User clarification requiring a brand-new browser window
